findings.observed: current_world() reads the current bytes of base_world()'s 25 paths, so the path set passed to evaluate() always equals BASE's. SOURCE_WORLD_PATH_SET_CHANGED is therefore reachable only for a caller-injected synthetic world (control 'modified-unrelated-module'); a new selector-matching file in the evaluated tree (e.g. a second production deliver caller in a new module) would not be discovered by evaluate(current_world()). The claim 'source-set changes reject' holds for injected worlds, not for tree discovery.
findings.actualSourceImpact: None for 746789a: reviewer P06 runs the selector on the HEAD tree itself (same 25 paths, 24 other blobs equal) and git name-status shows the only non-docs paths are dispatch.py and the test (outside the selector roots); P05 finds exactly one `.deliver` reference in the selector roots. The author's prepublication asserts (tracked == [dispatch], no untracked production) also covered it at WIP time.
findings.minimalFix: Before any reuse of finite_compatibility on source other than 746789a: derive the path set by running the selector on the evaluated tree (git grep on the target commit or an equivalent regex over its blobs) and compare with base_world(); keep 'modified-unrelated-module' as an injected control and add one tree-discovery control. No product or test change.

findings.text: Rejection tests observe the guard only through SYS-0001 / not_sent False / no deliver / one read; they cannot distinguish the guard's ValueError from another exception raised before the Delivery spy records. The AST proof pins the guard text, the line-205 BASE RED is causal and the zero-rich-call assertion is specific, so this is adequate. Optional: assert the exception type via a spy on finish inputs is not possible without changing once; no change required.

C2 'removing the guard recreates the foreign-value case' is evidenced by the real BASE RED (no capture, no guard, two reads; foreign-equal case only) rather than by a capture-without-guard mutant run. Static controls missing-type-gate/wrong-connective/widened-* plus reviewer RC02-RC04 cover guard removal/weakening at the AST layer. Acceptable; not an executed-mutant claim.

DeliveryQueue.finish keeps its own attempt.operation read (A7M-I2), reached only when a DomainError with not_sent is raised by deliver after a valid capture. Unchanged by this delta and unreachable with different values for the production frozen dataclass; the test fixture comment states it does not emulate that read.

If an invalid origin ever reached once in production, finish would apply the existing SYS-0001 uncertain backoff (<=30 s) and acquire would re-reserve with a literal operation, so no new liveness or stuck-lease behaviour is introduced. Today it is unreachable (P07).

Raw-log representation is truthful: the 3496 B original (sha 8a74f36b...) is absent as a standalone Git path, present in both WIP01 (36 entries) and WIP02 (52 entries) ZIPs, and embedded verbatim as rawUTF8 in review-original-local-doc-gates.raw.json (Git blob sha 5c6d7e0b..., 3835 B; embedded sha re-hashed by the reviewer = 8a74f36b...). The old manifests describe the frozen ZIPs, not standalone Git-path completeness. The Root post-CI packet .work/b-operation-7467-ci-review.zip (6aed7e34..., 16989615 B, 46 entries, manifest eeb1955b... with 45 files) is local uncommitted evidence, not published source.
